newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: DMCI raises capital, sets 100 pct stock div.
newsitem.headline: DMCI raises capital, sets 100 pct stock div.

text.p: Construction firm DMCI Holdings Inc said on Wednesday its board had approved an increase in its authorised capital to six billion pesos from 1.75 billion pesos to be effected through a 100 percent stock dividend.

The company told the Philippine Stock Exchange the new capital structure will comprise of 5.9 billion common shares and 100 million preferred shares, both of which will have a par value of one peso per share.
No record date has been set for the stock dividend.
